notes:
Account summary:
- Mid-market product analytics company building in-app product assistant + search.
- Started on Hosted API (good fit for fast iteration). Now moving to Dedicated for predictable cost and isolation as usage scales.

Technical / requirements (CSM/SE notes):
- Workloads: heavy embeddings for doc search (batching), chat support agents with context windows ~8k tokens, reranking pipeline for product recs.
- Latency/throughput targets: target p50 < 120ms for chat generation, p95 < 350ms; sustained throughput target ~200 req/s during daytime, spikey burst to 800 req/s for sales events.
- Model preferences: open-family models (Llama-3 style), prefer 8-bit/4-bit quantized builds for cost; willing to try Redwood-verified low-latency variants.
- Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to cheaper model variant if Dedicated pool saturated; prefer regional routing (US-East primary, EU for EU customers).

Security \u0026 compliance:
- Must have SSO (SAML) + SCIM user provisioning, audit logging retention 1 year, KMS integration for customer-managed keys, data residency controls for EU customers.
- Legal asked for DPA + addendum referencing SOC2/ISO27001.

Commercial notes / pricing preferences:
- Wants a 12-month committed Dedicated capacity with phased ramp: Q1 (baseline) 30% usage, Q2 60%, Q3 90%, Q4 100% of committed vGPU-hours.
- Needs explicit burst/bucket policy: allow 2x burst for 72 hours per month; overage pricing must be capped or tiered (customer dislikes open-ended per-token overage).
- Open to annual prepay in exchange for ~18-22% discount and committed guaranteed baseline throughput.
- Concern: how caching/prefix reuse affects billed units; asks for crediting mechanism for idle reserved capacity.

Conversations + direct quotes:
- "We need predictable unit economics — surprises in overage are the killer." — VP Product
- "Hosted iteration was fast; Dedicated is about cost and compliance at scale." — Head of Infrastructure

POC outcomes so far:
- Hosted API PoC validated quality and dev velocity.
- Dedicated demo showed autoscale + canary; real question is pricing model for ramp and burst.

Next steps / action items:
- AE (Jordan) to deliver revised proposal: 3 commit tiers (small/medium/large) with explicit ramp schedule and burst buckets + capped overage rates by 2026-03-03.
- SE (Maya) to map expected vGPU-hour consumption from their telemetry and propose quantization profile (4-bit) to hit cost targets.
- Legal to receive SOW + DPA draft; finance meeting with Lodestone on 2026-03-05.

Sticking points / risks:
- Procurement wants explicit ramp + SLA credits; finance wants ability to shift unused committed capacity between quarters.
- Legal wants a stronger data processing addendum (encryption-in-transit + residual data deletion clause).
- If overage/cap structure not acceptable, they may consider multi-vendor strategy (mix of Dedicated + spot-hosted).
pricing_discussion_summary: Current ask: 12-month dedicated commit with phased ramp, burst allowance (2x for limited windows), capped overage. Customer prefers prepay for discount (18-22%). Proposed options discussed: 1) 12mo commit baseline + monthly burst buckets + overage at 0.65x hosted per-token equivalent, 2) Annual prepay with 20% discount + transferable unused credits quarterly, 3) Pilot reserved pool (3 months) then scale with auto-convert to annual commit. Finance concerns: ability to reallocate unused committed capacity; require clear reporting (token-level + vGPU-hours).
